the_one_metric: Q2 DAU year-over-year growth rate and the Q3/FY bookings guide - the direct test of the AI-disruption thesis, not the 61c consensus EPS
whats_priced_in: That AI commoditises language learning and growth keeps decelerating - a stock 65.4% below its 52w high, three consecutive negative earnings reactions, and a BofA cut to Underperform ($93 PT) one day before the print say the bear story is fully told.
bear_case: The last three prints all guided down on DAU and margin (consensus EPS -33% y/y on AI content/infra spend); a fourth deceleration into a name still up 50% off its low produces another double-digit drawdown.
key_drivers: Retail-sourced implied move 12.6% vs 13.88% median historical - options priced for a violent print either way
Three consecutive negative reactions (-5.6%, -14.0%, -25.5%) is the dominant base rate
Consensus $297.4M revenue (+17.9%) / $0.61 EPS (-33% y/y); Zacks Rank #2, Earnings ESP +9.02%
BofA downgrade to Underperform $93 PT on 2026-08-04 - sell-side capitulation the day before
Stocktwits volume spiked to 24 msgs on 08-04 vs ~7 baseline; sentiment sharply split, not one-sided
what_would_change_my_mind: Evidence that DAU growth had already re-accelerated in Q2 or that the FY bookings guide had been de-risked, which would turn a coin-flip into a directional long.
reasoning: The bar has been reset hard: -65% from high, EPS consensus already down 33% y/y, and BofA capitulating to Underperform 24 hours before. That is a priced bear story. Against it, three straight down reactions and a real pattern of guide-downs on AI spend. Genuinely split on direction; the confident answer is size. Implied 12.6% and 5 of 8 prior moves exceeded it, so I sit near the implied rather than under it.

bear_case: Nat-gas curves and PJM capacity pricing rolled over into the quarter and management declines to raise 2026 guidance despite the acquisition, leaving a richly-valued IPP with no fresh catalyst.
key_drivers: Lawrenceburg/Waterford/Darby acquisition closed 2026-06-15 adds ~2.6 GW - first quarter of accretion guidance
Zacks Rank #2; 2026 consensus sales +68.3% and EPS +260.5% y/y
Wells Fargo PT $482 Overweight (raised 07-27) vs $329.84 spot - large sell-side upside already published
Earnings reactions historically muted: median 3.69%, max 6.52% over 8 events, despite 55.3% realised vol
Peer read-through: NRG reported 08-04 and the whole IPP group traded down on a green tape
what_would_change_my_mind: A pre-print disclosure of a new named hyperscaler contract or an explicit guidance range for the acquired assets, either of which would make the print directional rather than a non-event.
reasoning: TLN's realised vol is 55% but its earnings-day median is 3.69% - the stock moves on contracts, not quarters. Corpus gives me an industry note and thin social chatter (22 messages), no consensus figures, no guidance detail. That is genuinely no edge. Small positive tilt from the closed acquisition and a 20-day drawdown that lowered the bar. Size is the answer: expect a below-average-vol reaction unless a PPA lands with the release.

the_one_metric: HALEU/LEU enrichment expansion commentary - DOE contract scope, funded capacity additions and the deployment path for the $1.87B cash pile; Q2 SWU delivery timing is noise
whats_priced_in: A 17.5% five-day run into the print says retail has already bought the nuclear-for-AI bottom call, while the sell side has quietly cut: Roth $195 to $171 and JPMorgan $236 to $178, both Neutral.
bear_case: 26% short interest (retail-claimed) plus a beaten-down name means any credible HALEU capacity or DOE funding headline squeezes violently upward, as it did for +33%, +22% and +12% in prior quarters.
key_drivers: Consensus revenue $145.61M, -5.7% y/y; EPS $0.77 cut 16.3% over 60 days, -51.6% y/y
Run-up +17.5% over 5 days and +12.7% over 20 days directly into the event - classic fade setup
Two PT cuts in the fortnight before the print, both retaining Neutral
Realised vol 81.2% annualised; mean absolute reaction 17.6% over 8 events - the fattest tail in this batch
Stocktwits volume elevated (78 msgs, peaking 11 on event day) and lopsidedly bullish - crowded retail long
what_would_change_my_mind: A DOE award or funded capacity expansion disclosed with the release; the narrative catalyst overwhelms the deteriorating P&L in this name every time it appears.
reasoning: Estimates cut 16% in 60 days into declining revenue, two sell-side PT cuts holding Neutral, and a 17.5% run-up in the week before. That combination fades more often than it extends. But conviction on direction is genuinely low: this is a name that has printed +33%, +22% and +17% reactions, and a crowded short base cuts the other way. The real output is size - realised vol 81% and a 17.6% mean absolute reaction argue for a very large move regardless of sign.
